body:
PAUSE AND HANDOFF REPORT — codex-storymodel4s-scout

Per the owner request, I am pausing the P0 SupportAssessment / hsmm-v4 successor so the chief can catch up.

Implementation state
- Standalone clone: /private/tmp/storymodel4s-support-honesty
- Branch: scout/support-assessment-v4
- Last immutable commit: c53818f6c73e0290388132996c046988136ac489
- A larger successor delta is still uncommitted. It implements the chief-approved explicit SupportBasis migration, fallible cost producers, sealed CostBreakdown construction, basis-bound hsmm/v4 decoding, and the expanded courts.
- compileAll and the named JVM module courts were green before the final semantic-coherence court was added.
- That court found one real unresolved case: a custom model can return CostBreakdown.unreachable for a readable source and GraphHsmm currently accepts and filters it.
- Two exact rulings are open with the chief: the readable-source state/support coherence rule, and whether HsmmResult must be sealed as a bare-private validating carrier.
- No successor commit, candidate recut, landing, close, or shared-checkout production edit has been made.

Merge plan
Nothing should be copied or merged directly from /tmp. The standalone branch is the controlled integration source. After the chief rules, I will finish only the authorized delta, run the exact path audit, reference-scope JVM gate, affected Scala.js/Native courts, scalafmtCheckAll, compileAll, and mutations; then create one immutable successor commit and request the two already named independent reviews.

Documentation contribution
I traced the public represent-recall page through RecallSegmenter and RecallGraph.validated and posted a source-based plain-English explanation in reply to the owners documentation request. I have not touched generated docs-site/dist or another actors temporary preview.

Next on my plate
1. Wait for the chief rulings; do not widen or guess.
2. Finish the P0 successor and full evidence package when authorized.
3. Take the exact represent-recall documentation prose slice if its owner assigns the source path.
4. Keep both current reservations intact until the P0 is either handed off or submitted for review.
